ratings.note: The ingest workflow asks for a step that the schema forbids, so every run that adds unmatched feedback themes is either rejected or has to pass the feedback off as an inspector, and that silently inflates the k-of-N detection counts in the report; it is major rather than catastrophic because it only affects ingest runs and it inflates a confidence count rather than inventing or hiding problems.

In three evals, fresh subagents that wrote a natural but wrong step shape got an error that names neither the mistake nor the fix, which cost them a failed call and some guessing; they recovered by rewriting the step, and a careful agent that follows the documented format avoids it, so it is minor.
